verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's documented model is a cloud-authenticated SaaS (magic-link sign-in, referral credits, usage-based plans/tiers) with a 'self-hosted-models' feature that only lets you plug in your own OpenAI-compatible model provider — not self-host the ByteAsk product itself. No evidence pack item describes an on-prem/self-hosted deployment of the ByteAsk service, a Docker image, or an open-source server component.
